extractions.value: PERM preceded by neurobrucellosis (Brucella spp. PCR positive in CSF); anti-GlyR antibodies positive in serum and CSF; rituximab appeared to be the most beneficial immunotherapy; patient had hip fractures due to severe spasms and osteoporosis from prolonged immobility; 12-month ICU stay; at 24 months walks with a walker and is relapse free.
extractions.quote: We report a patient with progressive encephalomyelitis with rigidity and myoclonus (PERM) associated with anti-GlyR antibodies in the CSF and serum possibly triggered by Brucella spp. who improved after 12 months in an ICU following intense immunotherapy
